findings.title: FULL_PREREGISTERED_TERMINAL_PREDICATE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED
findings.required_fix: Compute exact 72-object and three-day completion, every layer conservation equation, per-unit-universe unclassifiable group and occurrence counts, exact-once proof foreign keys, provenance joins, output hashes and byte counts before any complete-taxonomy terminal.

findings.title: HARDCODED_PROOF_RESOLUTION_CLAIM
findings.required_fix: Remove hard-coded proof claims and derive all_proof_references_resolve only from exact validated foreign-key joins.

findings.title: PARTIAL_SCIENCE_AND_FAILURE_ARTIFACT_SEMANTICS_INVALID
findings.required_fix: Differentiate fully materialized incomplete science from true early stop, make all seven scientific containers exactly empty only for early stop or cap fallback, and emit a complete minimal deterministic artifact for every allowed failure.

findings.title: WORKFLOW_STAGE_VALIDATOR_CONTRADICTION
findings.required_fix: Use separate inert implementation, approval, role, preflight, installation, release, activation and evidence validators; the future workflow must never call an inert-stage validator that forbids its own installed stage.

findings.title: RUNTIME_EVIDENCE_SCHEMAS_AND_FOREIGN_KEYS_INCOMPLETE
findings.required_fix: Implement exact status-dependent object rows, 512 reducer rows, ordered stop ledger, complete resource ledger, context lineage, proof files and exact-once foreign-key validation.

findings.title: TAXONOMY_PREDICATES_NOT_GROUP_WIDE
findings.required_fix: Evaluate TID scope, intra-block repetition and replay predicates over complete equality groups and all distinct raw locators, not only first/current pairs.

findings.title: RESOURCE_AND_RUNTIME_BOUNDS_NOT_ENFORCED_END_TO_END
findings.required_fix: Reserve and measure workspace before writes, include final artifact staging in the same 5 GiB root, stream outputs, bound equality groups, enforce runtime through parse, sort, classify, seal, cleanup and pre-upload, and retain packaging/upload reserve.

findings.title: EXTERNAL_SORT_MULTISET_EQUALITY_NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_PROVEN
findings.required_fix: Compare source and destination with independent order-insensitive, multiplicity-sensitive commitments in addition to count, bytes and sorted stream digest.

findings.title: PRICING_AND_EUR_SNAPSHOT_NOT_BOUND
findings.required_fix: Freeze provider pricing and EUR-conversion evidence before approval and enforce a runtime budget predicate before OIDC and every request.

findings.title: LEGACY_DECIMAL_NORMALIZER_CONTEXT_DEPENDENT
findings.required_fix: Replace Decimal.quantize based normalization with context-independent exact integral normalization and adversarial exponent tests.

findings.title: CANONICAL_MAPPING_ORDER_AND_PACKAGE_BOUNDARY_NOT_FULLY_VALIDATED
findings.required_fix: Canonicalize mapping keys by UTF-8 bytes, validate every package-boundary formula and require all success booleans to equal one.

findings.title: TOP_LEVEL_GOVERNANCE_DRIFT
findings.required_fix: Update PROJECT_STATE.md, ROADMAP.md and README.md to the RED-contained corrective state and dedicated successor-role decision.

findings.title: NESTED_FILL_PAYLOAD_NOT_DEEPLY_IMMUTABLE
findings.required_fix: Store a deep immutable canonical payload snapshot so hashes and retained values cannot diverge after parsing.

findings.title: ARTIFACT_UPLOAD_PRECEDES_VALIDATION
findings.required_fix: Validate terminal class, hashes, empty/full semantics, ledgers, package boundary and zero wallet-feature output before upload.

findings.title: ATOMIC_OUTPUT_AND_CLEANUP_NOT_FAIL_CLOSED
findings.required_fix: Perform all checks before atomic rename, never leave a committed directory after failure, and make cleanup failures explicit rather than ignore_errors.

findings.title: SCIENTIFIC_OUTPUT_MATERIALIZED_BEFORE_CAP_DECISION
findings.required_fix: Stream NDJSON and enforce scientific and total artifact reservations before each record write, with deterministic empty fallback on breach.

findings.title: EQUALITY_GROUP_MEMORY_UNBOUNDED
findings.required_fix: Spool each complete equality group to bounded workspace and classify by streaming or repeated bounded passes without a full in-memory list.

findings.title: RELEASE_AND_EXECUTION_BINDING_INCOMPLETE
findings.required_fix: Future release must bind approval hash, release ID and blob hash, exact commit, workflow, collector, validator and selection hashes, single run ID and immutable consumption.

findings.title: POST_OIDC_PRINCIPAL_EVIDENCE_ABSENT
findings.required_fix: Retain minimized exact sts:GetCallerIdentity account, role-session ARN and session name evidence before S3 access.

findings.title: ADVERSARIAL_TEST_MATRIX_INCOMPLETE
findings.required_fix: Add dangling-FK, non-empty-incomplete, cleanup, post-rename, huge-group, nested-key-order, false-boundary, artifact-outside-workspace and stage-validator contradiction tests.

findings.title: MAIN_MERGE_GUARD_ABSENT
findings.required_fix: Do not merge corrective work on red CI; require exact-head Research CI and clean-context review before any approval-eligible merge.
